environment.percentileMethod: nearest rank; successful samples only; errors separately reported
environment.topology: client HTTPS/WSS -> EC2 Nginx; backend helpers in one-off production image; two client browsers forced through hosted TURN

metrics.name: HTTP health latency and throughput
notes: Request start through complete JSON response; not a database query or one-way network latency. HTTP connections may be reused.

metrics.name: Verified TLS handshake
notes: Includes name resolution, TCP connect, and a fresh TLS handshake; excludes HTTP. Negotiated protocol is not an exhaustive server cipher audit.

metrics.name: JWT session verification latency
metrics.scope: in-process real verifySessionToken, valid HS256 token
notes: Crypto and claim validation only; excludes HTTP, cookies, database work, and password hashing.

metrics.name: Authentication and authorization case coverage
metrics.scope: enumerated fixture cases, real application helpers and HTTP routes
notes: Coverage of this explicit test matrix only; not penetration-test coverage or a claim that all attacks are prevented. Positive controls detect a deny-everything implementation.

metrics.name: Redis pub/sub fan-out latency
metrics.scope: production Redis, three benchmark subscribers on EC2
notes: Each sample is publisher enqueue through a subscriber callback; includes client/event-loop overhead. Subscriber deliveries from one publication are correlated.

metrics.name: Redis-backed burst rate-limit enforcement
metrics.scope: production Redis, dedicated run-owned rate bucket
notes: A fixed 40-request synthetic burst against a 20-request bucket, not a DDoS capacity claim. The Redis counter/TTL check detects silent in-memory fallback.

metrics.name: Indexed room authorization lookup
notes: Times the real assertRoomAccess ORM operation including recording lookup, connection pool wait, and DB round trips.
EXPLAIN is separately captured representative SQL, not an exact trace of every Prisma query. Seed and ANALYZE are outside timed samples.

metrics.name: Authenticated WebSocket room join
notes: TCP/WebSocket upgrade, server JWT verification, and authorized peers response; client token creation and close teardown excluded.

metrics.name: SDP/ICE routing round-trip and delivery
metrics.scope: two authorized fixture peers, real signaling server
notes: Application message echo through both peer routes with automatic ACKs; payloads are synthetic negotiation messages, not an SDP parsing test. No WAN packet loss is injected.

metrics.name: Selective-repeat S3 upload goodput and integrity
metrics.scope: client -> hosted authenticated upload API -> presigned regional S3 PUTs
notes: Fixed 0x5a bytes; one controlled lost application ACK for part 2 forces retransmission with real production backoff.
Goodput includes presigning, retries, status validation; excludes initialization and corruption probe.

Actual S3 checksum enforcement and listed per-part SHA-256 comparison. Multipart session is aborted during cleanup; completion/download are not exercised because the production IAM policy intentionally lacks DeleteObject.

metrics.scope: two same-host Chromium processes, forced TURN relay
notes: Synthetic video and same-host peers; do not label these values as real-user WAN or cross-region performance.
From offer request to both connected peers, first decoded video, and a data-channel echo. Browser launch and room join excluded.
metrics.name: WebRTC media establishment latency

metrics.scope: two same-host Chromium processes, forced TURN relay
notes: Synthetic video and same-host peers; do not label these values as real-user WAN or cross-region performance.
Browser candidate-pair currentRoundTripTime in milliseconds; not one-way media latency or glass-to-glass delay. Repeated getStats observations are correlated.
metrics.name: Selected ICE path round-trip time

metrics.scope: two same-host Chromium processes, forced TURN relay
notes: Synthetic video and same-host peers; do not label these values as real-user WAN or cross-region performance.
Loss = sum(max(0, delta packetsLost)) / (sum(delta packetsReceived) + sum(max(0, delta packetsLost))).
Late-arrival negative loss deltas are retained as corrections; reset/missing counters are excluded. This is an interval estimate, not proof of zero lifetime loss.
metrics.name: Video RTP packet loss and jitter

metrics.scope: two same-host Chromium processes, forced TURN relay
notes: Synthetic video and same-host peers; do not label these values as real-user WAN or cross-region performance.
Drop ratio uses delta framesDropped / (delta framesDecoded + delta framesDropped).
This measures receiver-reported drops, not every frame captured/sent/missing before reception. FPS = delta framesDecoded / stats timestamp delta seconds.
metrics.name: Receiver video frame drops and decoded FPS

metrics.scope: two same-host Chromium processes, forced TURN relay
notes: Synthetic video and same-host peers; do not label these values as real-user WAN or cross-region performance.
Runs the real IceRecovery class, requires changed ICE credentials, a stable answered negotiation, connected ICE, and a data echo.
A deliberate ICE restart on a working path; does not simulate physical Wi-Fi/cellular handover, offline time, or a blackholed network.
metrics.name: Controlled ICE restart recovery
